title: Ton
summary: TON, the termination of names of places, is town. TON, noun The prevailing fashion. TON, noun The weight of twenty hundred gross. [See Tun.] This is false orthography. The word is from the Saxon tunna

inlines.v: TON, the termination of names of places, is town. TON, noun The prevailing fashion. TON, noun The weight of twenty hundred gross. [See Tun.] This is false orthography. The word is from the Saxon tunna, a cask, and the sense of weight is taken from that of a cask or butt.
